interface_type_note: Dominant surface is a request-builder form (state + typed questions) with a data-output column (decisions, metrics) and an export dock; evaluated as form per the dominant type, with dashboard rules applied to the metrics panel.

findings.message: On mobile the primary Run action sits at the top of the output column, which falls below the entire builder (state + question cards). After editing a question the user must scroll a long distance to run, increasing effort per iteration and reducing experiment throughput.
findings.remediation: Add a sticky bottom run bar on viewports under 1024px (fixed, safe-area padded) showing the Run button and the validation summary; keep the in-column RunBar on desktop. Measure: Run is reachable without scrolling from any scroll position on mobile.

findings.message: The noul answer shows a derived 'confidence' value (0.5 + |p-0.5|) alongside the probability. Without an explicit label, users may read it as a correctness guarantee, which the model does not provide; the docs state confidence describes the distribution, not accuracy.
findings.remediation: Label the noul value explicitly as certainty derived from the distribution, and add a one-line transparency note under every confidence readout: 'describes the distribution, not guaranteed correctness'. Also surface the auto/review/abstain threshold semantics in the same tooltip.

findings.message: The API key field is a masked password input with no reveal toggle. Users who mistype or paste a truncated key cannot visually verify it, turning a preventable error into a failed validation round trip.
findings.remediation: Add a show/hide (eye) toggle beside the key input and keep the validate action as the confirmation step. Measure: key-entry related validation failures drop after the toggle ships.

findings.message: The metrics panel presents 9 simultaneous stat tiles, slightly beyond the 7±2 working-memory band for first-glance scanning. Latency, tokens and cost are the primary readouts; the rest are secondary.
findings.remediation: Keep latency, input tokens, output tokens and cost in the first row and collapse provider/resolved model/generation id into a secondary line or the generation-stats disclosure.

findings.message: Compact ghost buttons (add option, remove row, theme toggle) sit around 28-32px tall, under the 44px comfortable touch target on mobile.
findings.remediation: Set a minimum 36px height on icon/ghost buttons and 44px on primary CTAs; verify on a 375px viewport.

findings.message: Advanced fields (model alias, session_id, user) are already collapsed, but the raw answer JSON details block and the request-model tab are discoverable only by exploring; a first-time user may not know export options exist.
findings.remediation: Keep the tabs, and add a single hint line under the inspector title naming the four surfaces (JSON body, request model, cURL, Postman) so the export capability is discoverable without clicking.

strengths.message: Offline concept validation blocks the Run action on hard errors and warns on known Jev failure patterns (compound questions, math/dates, text-generation asks) before any token is spent.
A prefilled sample triage request (state + one question per primitive) lets users understand the state/questions/decisions mental model and run a real decision within seconds.

One accent colour, one radius system, semantic band colours used only for real state (auto/review/abstain), and labels above inputs with helper text and inline errors follow a single form pattern everywhere.
Full state cycle: skeleton loading during the run, toasts for completion/failure/export, band badges with explanation on hover, and an empty state that says how to populate.

api_note: Install the uxuiprinciples API key for enriched findings with citations and business impact data. See uxuiprinciples.com/en/checkout
